params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P3
Summary: Try letting the audience pieces of the home ("Built for professionals who need to get it right.") take turns in a loop with the collage at the top of the home and with the graph, and see what that gives.

## What is asked

An experiment, not a decision: a version where these visuals alternate, to look at before choosing.

## Open question

It is not clear which place the loop is meant for: the hero band at the top (collage, then the torn-paper audience cluster, then the graph), or the audience section itself (the torn-paper cluster alternating with a crop of the collage and the graph). The answer decides what gets built.

Source: Portal mail:49.
params.title: Try the audience pieces alternating in a loop with the home collage and the graph
